description: email.rs lines 281-290: apply_header_form has five consecutive TODO(RFC 8621 §4.1.2) comments in committed production code: AsAddresses, AsGroupedAddresses, AsDate, AsMessageIds, and AsURLs all return Value::Null with TODO comments. Per project CLAUDE.md conventions: 'Never leave... TODO comments... in committed code.' These TODOs are load-bearing (they explain intentional silent nulls) but belong in Beads issues, not source comments. The linked existing finding JMAP-yqo.11 tracks the functional issue; the TODO comments themselves are a process violation that will confuse contributors who see them in a library API.
title: TODO comments in apply_header_form committed to library code
